column3: NKJV has “tell you to observe, that observe and do,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “tell you, do and observe.”
NKJV includes “of their garments,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “enlarge the tassels.” “Tassels” is rendered “borders.”
NKJV repeats “Rabbi, Rabbi,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “Rabbi” once.
NKJV includes “the Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “One is your Teacher.”
Close to the Greek; “instructors” is rendered “teachers.”
This verse is absent from the critical text; NKJV includes it following the Textus Receptus (the woe on those who “devour widows' houses”).
Close to the Greek; “convert” is rendered “proselyte.”
Close to the Greek; “is bound” is rendered “is obliged to perform it.”
NKJV includes “Fools and,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “Blind men!”
Close to the Greek; “dill” is rendered “anise,” and “faithfulness” as “faith.”
Close to the Greek; “greed” is rendered “extortion.”
NKJV includes “and dish,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “the inside of the cup.”
